quirks.name: Homesick
quirks.line: It watches the wrong part of the sky every night. It fights like it, until it trusts you.

quirks.name: Smoke Crier
quirks.line: It cries white smoke whenever you win a badge. It is crying from joy, and it grows fonder each time.

quirks.name: Victory Dancer
quirks.line: It dances every time you beat a Gym, and it grows fonder of you each time.

quirks.name: Won't Fall
quirks.line: It flew through the storm once. Once per battle an Electric move that would knock it out leaves it at 1 HP.

quirks.name: Slow Kindling
quirks.line: Its flames won't catch at the start of a fight. Its Fire moves are 20% weaker until Bond 3, then 10% stronger for good.

quirks.name: Dreamer
quirks.line: It watches the fish and wants to be something else. As a Poliwhirl it becomes a Politoed at level 36, without a King's Rock.

quirks.name: Protector
quirks.line: It guards the weak. Once per battle it takes a hit that would knock out a teammate, and holds on at 1 HP or more.

quirks.name: Slow to Trust
quirks.line: It has been let down before. Its Bond grows at half speed until Bond 3, then twice as fast.

quirks.name: Old Hand
quirks.line: It's slow. It's clever. Its first move after coming out has +1 priority.
